ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift
ordered_steps.summary: Identify and document schema drift in the translator before removing the legacy parser shim that currently masks the issue.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report with list of divergent fields and affected paths

ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures
ordered_steps.summary: Update test fixtures to reflect the new schema so the plan contract catches ordering regressions.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated fixtures in tests/plan_contract.py that pass with new step ids

ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch
ordered_steps.summary: Activate the translated release-plan dashboard summary feature with a kill switch once schema is stable.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature enabled behind kill switch in canary

ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist
ordered_steps.summary: Document rollout and rollback procedures after the summary path is proven in canary.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook with rollout/rollback procedures and launch checklist

dependency_notes.reason: Schema drift must be audited and understood before fixtures can be correctly backfilled to reflect the new schema
Dashboard summary consumes step-id schema from translator and must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema
Runbook requires known rollout and rollback shapes which are only established after dashboard summary is proven in canary

primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect step ordering to users if schema drift is not audited and fixtures are not backfilled before enabling the dashboard
mitigations: Complete schema drift audit (RN-101) before any dashboard work
Backfill fixtures and verify plan_contract.py passes (RN-102) before enabling dashboard
Keep dashboard behind kill switch for rapid rollback if ordering issues detected

assumption_ledger.note: No detailed inventory of schema drift exists; audit in RN-101 will reveal actual scope
Kill switch infrastructure for dashboard summary feature not explicitly documented in repo_inventory
Rollback procedures for dashboard feature not documented until RN-104 completes
